```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center",
                      fig.height = 5,
                      fig.width = 10,
                      out.width = "100%",
                      warning = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```

```{r prep, include=FALSE}
# Plot theme shared by the fitted plots
fit_theme <- ggplot2::theme(
  axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7),
  legend.position = "bottom"
)

# Formats a named list such as `roll_mean`/`roll_sum`/`lag`/`nl` (e.g.
# list(tmax = c(1, 3))) as a compact bullet-friendly string
fmt_named_list <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {
    return("none")
  }
  vals <- vapply(x, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")
  paste(sprintf("`%s` = %s", names(x), vals), collapse = "; ")
}

# Anchored, literal patterns to attribute a model term to a covariate
cov_lin_pattern <- function(cov) paste0("^", stringr::str_escape(cov), "\\.")
cov_nl_pattern <- function(cov) {
  paste0("^INLA::inla\\.group\\(", stringr::str_escape(cov), "\\.")
}

# Objects
results <- params$results
unit_var <- results$params$unit
time_var <- results$params$time
metrics <- results$params$metric
# Preserve the covariates' original input order; fall back to the (alpha-
# betically sorted) GoF table for results saved before 'params$covariates'
# was added
covariates <- results$params$covariates
if (is.null(covariates)) {
  covariates <- unique(results$fe_uni_gof$covariate)
}

if (!is.null(unit_var)) {
  unit_n <- length(unique(results$data[[unit_var]]))
} else {
  unit_n <- 0
}
```

Two-stage fixed effect model selection procedure:

- **Best configuration**: Fits, ranks and selects univariable fixed effect
models by covariate (rolling averages, lags, non-linear) according to
goodness of fit metrics.
- **Best combination**: Generates, fits, and ranks multivariable
combinations of the selected univariable fixed effects.

The **random effects structure** for all models is: 

```{r, results='asis'}
cat(paste0("- ", results$params$re_form, collapse = "\n"))
```

The **covariate(s)** included in the analysis:

```{r, results='asis'}
cat(paste0("- ", covariates, collapse = "\n"))
```

The settings used for all models:

```{r, results='asis'}
p <- results$params
offset_txt <- if (is.null(p$offset_var)) {
  "none"
} else {
  paste0("`", p$offset_var, "`")
}
standardize_txt <- if (is.null(p$standardize) || identical(p$standardize, "")) {
  "none"
} else {
  paste(paste0("`", p$standardize, "`"), collapse = ", ")
}
cat(paste0(
  "- **Outcome**: `", p$outcome, "`\n",
  "- **Family**: `", p$family, "`\n",
  "- **Offset**: ", offset_txt, "\n",
  "- **Ranking metric(s)**: ",
  paste(paste0("`", p$metric, "`"), collapse = ", "), "\n",
  "- **Rolling means**: ", fmt_named_list(p$roll_mean), "\n",
  "- **Rolling sums**: ", fmt_named_list(p$roll_sum), "\n",
  "- **Lags**: ", fmt_named_list(p$lag), "\n",
  "- **Non-linear terms**: ", fmt_named_list(p$nl), "\n",
  "- **Standardized covariates**: ", standardize_txt, "\n"
))
```

Please see the documentation of the function `select_fe()` for more information.


# Best configuration

```{r setup-uni-mods}
# Prepare univariable results
uni_gof <- results$fe_uni_gof

# Prepare univariable table
tab_uni <- uni_gof[
  c("covariate", "model_id",
    "type", "roll", "lag", "covariate_1", metrics, "final_rank")
] |>
  dplyr::rename(alias = covariate_1)
uni_selected <- results$fe_uni_selected
uni_selected <- unlist(lapply(uni_selected, names))
tab_uni$selected <- tab_uni$model_id %in% uni_selected
```

```{r uni-mods, results='asis'}
for (cov in covariates) {

  cat("##", cov, "{.tabset}\n\n")

  # Gof table
  cat("### Model table {.unnumbered}\n\n")
  tab_cov <- tab_uni[tab_uni$covariate %in% cov, ]
  print(knitr::kable(tab_cov, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("### Fitted (selected) {.unnumbered}\n\n")
  # Predicted vs. fitted
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text = paste0(
      "```{r, fig.width=9, out.width='100%', fig.height=4+floor(unit_n/4)}\n",
      "plot_fit(",
      "  results$fe_uni_mod,",
      "  mod_id = tab_cov$model_id[tab_cov$selected],",
      "  time = time_var,",
      "  unit = unit_var,",
      "  palette = 'Set1',",
      "  transform = 'log10p1') + \n",
      "fit_theme\n",
      "```\n"
    ),
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ))
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("### Fitted (all) {.unnumbered}\n\n")
  # Predicted vs. fitted
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text = paste0(
      "```{r, fig.width=9, out.width='100%', fig.height=4+floor(unit_n/4)+floor(nrow(tab_cov)/5)*0.25}\n",
      "plot_fit(",
      "  results$fe_uni_mod,",
      "  mod_id = tab_cov$model_id,",
      "  time = time_var,",
      "  unit = unit_var,",
      "  palette = 'Set1',",
      "  transform = 'log10p1') + \n",
      "fit_theme\n",
      "```\n"
    ),
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ))
  cat("\n\n")

  # Linear
  cat("### Linear effects {.unnumbered}\n\n")
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text = paste0(
      "```{r, fig.width=9, out.width='90%'}\n",
      "plot_coef_lin(\n",
      "  results$fe_uni_mod,\n",
      "  pattern = cov_lin_pattern(cov))\n",
      "```\n"
    ),
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ))
  cat("\n\n")

  # Non-linear
  if (any(grepl("Non-linear", tab_cov$type))) {

    cat("### Non-linear effects {.unnumbered}\n\n")

    cat(knitr::knit_child(
      text = paste0(
        "```{r, fig.height=2, fig.width=8, out.width='70%'}\n",
        "mods_nl <- tab_cov$model_id[grepl('Non-linear', tab_cov$type)]\n",
        "for (mnl in mods_nl) {",
        "print(plot_coef_nl(results$fe_uni_mod,\n",
        "  mod_id = mnl,\n",
        "  pattern = cov_nl_pattern(cov)))\n",
        "}\n",
        "```\n"
      ),
      envir = environment(),
      quiet = TRUE
    ))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Best combination

```{r setup-multi-mods}
# Prepare multivariable results
multi_gof <- results$fe_multi_gof

# Prepare multivariable table: take the actual 'covariate_*' columns present
# rather than assuming there are length(covariates) of them
covariate_cols <- grep("^covariate_", names(multi_gof), value = TRUE)
tab_multi <- multi_gof[
  c("model_id", covariate_cols, metrics, "final_rank")
]
multi_selected <- names(results$fe_multi_selected)
tab_multi$selected <- tab_multi$model_id %in% multi_selected
```

## Summary{.tabset}

### Model table{.unnumbered}
```{r multi-gof}
knitr::kable(tab_multi, row.names = FALSE)
```

### Fitted (selected){.unnumbered}
```{r multi-fit1, fig.height=4+floor(unit_n/4)}
plot_fit(
  results$fe_multi_mod,
  time = time_var,
  mod_id = tab_multi$model_id[tab_multi$selected],
  unit = unit_var,
  palette = "Set1",
  transform = "log10p1"
) +
  fit_theme
```

### Fitted (all){.unnumbered}
```{r multi-fit2, fig.height=4+floor(unit_n/4)+floor(nrow(tab_multi)/5)*0.25}
plot_fit(
  results$fe_multi_mod,
  time = time_var,
  mod_id = tab_multi$model_id,
  unit = unit_var,
  palette = "Set1",
  transform = "log10p1"
) +
  fit_theme
```
```{r multi, results='asis'}
# Only the covariate_* columns hold model terms; the metric/id columns must
# not be searched
covariate_cols <- names(tab_multi)[startsWith(names(tab_multi), "covariate_")]
cov_terms <- tab_multi[, covariate_cols, drop = FALSE]

for (cov in covariates) {

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("##", cov, " effects{.tabset}\n\n")

  lin_re <- cov_lin_pattern(cov)
  matches_cov <- apply(cov_terms, 1, function(row) any(grepl(lin_re, row)))
  matches_nl <- apply(cov_terms, 1, function(row) {
    any(grepl("_nl_", row, fixed = TRUE) & grepl(lin_re, row))
  })
  n_lin <- sum(matches_cov & !matches_nl)
  n_nl <- sum(matches_nl)

  if (n_lin > 0) {
    cat("### Linear effects {.unnumbered}\n\n")
    cat(knitr::knit_child(
      text = paste0(
        "```{r, fig.width=9, out.width='90%'}\n",
        "plot_coef_lin(\n",
        "  results$fe_multi_mod,\n",
        "  pattern = cov_lin_pattern(cov))\n",
        "```\n"
      ),
      envir = environment(),
      quiet = TRUE
    ))
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  if (n_nl > 0) {
    mods_nl <- tab_multi$model_id[matches_nl]
    cat("### Non-linear effects {.unnumbered}\n\n")
    cat(knitr::knit_child(
      text = paste0(
        "```{r, fig.height=2, fig.width=8, out.width='70%'}\n",
        "for (modnl in mods_nl) {\n",
        "print(plot_coef_nl(results$fe_multi_mod,\n",
        "  mod_id = modnl,\n",
        "  pattern = cov_nl_pattern(cov)))\n",
        "}\n",
        "```\n"
      ),
      envir = environment(),
      quiet = TRUE
    ))
  }
}
```

# Final model

The model with the best results is the following:

* **Random effects**: `r results$params$re_form` 
* **Fixed effects**: `r results$best`
